source.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Monthly Retail Trade (mrtssales92-present.xlsx, downloaded Nov 3, 2026): jewelry stores, NAICS 44831, not seasonally adjusted; monthly sales ÷ that year's monthly mean, averaged over 2017-2019. ad_cost_source.source: Gupta Media, Meta (Facebook + Instagram) average CPM by month, 2024 and 2025; each month ÷ that year's monthly mean, averaged over the two years. Latest full years with a monthly series; 2026 only runs to September (AdKit worldwide medians) and a partial year cannot be normalized to an annual mean

note: Indexes are relative to an average month (mean 1.0). Applied as a prior for the month being planned; never used to calibrate or backtest, because one year of a brand's history cannot separate seasonality from everything else.
